segmente.text: There is no winning product and there never has been. The idea of finding the
one winning product is an illusion sold by coaches. The truth is your marketing
and branding will always make or break your business. Boring products with great
marketing will win over fancy products with bad marketing. Dollar Shave Club
sells razors. Liquid Death sells water. Both built billion-dollar brands by
selling boring products. So it's never the product it's the branding and the
story you tell about it and this is why
